subject: Hosted API pricing format — can Redwood accept BrightMap's PO structure?
messages:
From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: susan.park@brightmap.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is the pricing schedule that maps monthly commit tiers to per-token unit pricing for the Hosted API. Key points in the attached:  
- Committed monthly credits (prepay model) that give deep per-token discounts
- Monthly true-up for usage that exceeds the committed credits (billed at the overage rate)
- Option to add a small buffer for burst traffic (one-off bursts billed separately)

Can you confirm BrightMap's preferred PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether your procurement team needs line-item pricing that looks like a fixed SKU per month? I know you mentioned your preferred vendor form — if you send it over we can confirm acceptance and any legal redlines.

Attaching: Redwood_Pricing_Schedule_v3.pdf

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: procurement@brightmap.com
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: susan.park@brightmap.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the schedule. A few things from procurement that will determine how quickly we can issue a PO: 

1) Preferred vendor form: attached is BrightMap's standard vendor form and our procurement checklist. We require acceptance of the form for preferred suppliers. Please confirm you can sign as-is or indicate which sections you cannot accept.

2) Invoice structure: our finance prefers a monthly PO with fixed line items — we are trying to avoid per-API-call variable invoices. Is it possible for Redwood to accept a monthly committed credit PO that Redwood invoices as a single line item (e.g., "Redwood Hosted API — May 2027 — Committed Credits") and then true-up usage internally? We need the external invoice to match the PO line items for AP reconciliation.

3) Payment terms: BrightMap operates on NET-60. Will Redwood accept NET-60 for enterprise customers under $1M ARR?

4) Tax and remittance: confirm Redwood's billing address and tax ID for the PO.

Attached: PreferredVendorForm_BrightMap_filled.pdf

Please route this to your billing/legal team and let me know.

Regards,
Procurement Team
BrightMap Analytics
procurement@brightmap.com

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: procurement@brightmap.com
Cc: susan.park@brightmap.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Hi —

Appreciate the details and the filled vendor form. Quick answers up-front: 
- We can accept a monthly PO that references a committed credits SKU and issue a single invoice line for that committed amount. Overage usage will be tracked and invoiced separately as a monthly true-up line item (we can include a short note on invoices referencing the PO number).
- NET-60 needs approval from finance for new customers; standard is NET-30 but we can escalate NET-60 for strategic accounts. I'll confirm with finance (cc'ing Marissa).
- Redwood's billing address and tax ID: Redwood Inference Inc., 600 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105, Tax ID: 94-XXXXXXX.

Open question: the vendor form contains an indemnity clause (Section 7) that our legal team often requests to be narrowed for SaaS/API consumption. Grace, can you review the attached form and flag any non-starters?

Alex

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, procurement@brightmap.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed BrightMap's vendor form. Two items require negotiation: 

- Section 7 (Indemnity): language is overly broad, seeks indemnity for BrightMap's use in ways that could expose Redwood. We can accept a mutual indemnity limited to Redwood's gross negligence/willful misconduct.  
- Section 12 (Data retention & audit rights): the customer requests unlimited audit rights and access to infra logs. We can offer audit rights with 30-day notice and a bounded scope (production access summary, not full infra/live logs).

Operationally on the billing ask: we can invoice the committed credits as a single line item monthly. For true-ups, we can issue a second line item ("Usage true-up - May 2027") and reference the PO number on that invoice. That satisfies AP requirements.  

Marissa: can you advise on NET-60 escalation?

Grace O'Connor
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Quick finance check: 
- NET-60 is acceptable for strategic customers with an approved credit review. For BrightMap's initial commit level ($55k/month committed credits) we can approve NET-60 once sales completes the credit application and we have an executed order form. 
- We prefer the PO to reference the deal id (BM-2027-045) so reconciliation is smooth. 

Please let procurement know we can do NET-60 conditioned on credit approval and an executed order form. Also confirm that BrightMap is okay with the two-line monthly invoice approach (Committed Credits + True-up).

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: susan.park@brightmap.com, procurement@brightmap.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & commit options — next steps

Hi Susan / Procurement team —

Thanks for the vendor form. We can accept BrightMap's preferred vendor process with two standard redlines: 1) narrow the indemnity to Redwood's gross negligence/willful misconduct, and 2) limit audit rights to scheduled reviews with a scoped checklist. Finance will approve NET-60 after a routine credit review; we need an executed order form referencing BM-2027-045 to proceed.

Next steps I propose: 
- BrightMap: confirm PO cadence (monthly preferred) and confirm you will reference BM-2027-045 on the PO.
- BrightMap: sign and return the vendor form or indicate acceptance of the two redlines above.
- Redwood: I will send an updated order form and the invoice template showing the two-line monthly invoice.

If you want, we can set a 30-minute call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Alex
